facts.text: Pretoria, Bloemfontein and Cape Town share capital-city roles.
Languages spoken here include Zulu, Xhosa, Afrikaans and English.
It is a coastal country in Southern Africa.

culture.text: A braai combines cooking over a wood or charcoal fire with a social gathering, often at weekends.

food.name: Bunny chow
food.text: A hollowed bread loaf filled with curry is associated with Durban's Indian community.
